message: セレ武な二人

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahh, it's Synn-kun! Hey, hey, can you tell what this is?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good day to you, President」

name: Synn
message: 「What is this...?」
I run into Sacchin and Misasagi-senpai on the route to and from school. They must be walking home together.
The moment Sacchin spots me, she abruptly hands me a palm-sized, black cylindrical object.

name: Synn
message: 「No matter how you look at it, it's a fountain pen. I didn't know you favored old-fashioned writing instruments, Sacchin」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That belongs to me, actually. I received it from my uncle the other day」

name: Sacchin
message: 「See, it's really high quality, yet it seems to be broken!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see here. Senpai, mind if I fiddle with it?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I do not mind at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? No ink is coming out?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's pretty heavy, though! It's definitely full of ink!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Might it be clogged?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, maybe tapping it will fix it? Still, there's no way he'd gift something defective like that to his own niece--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Iroma!?」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Paqy...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「A bullet right in my gut... If I weren't a stuffed animal... I'd be a goner... *slump*」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ohhh, so it was a concealed weapon!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ho, ho... I understand completely now」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What? Uhh, white smoke that smells like gunpowder is rising from the fountain pen?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun, let me see that one more time!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe, the craftsmanship on this is pretty elaborate!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I wonder about that? If it cannot be used for writing like a real one, it is bound to arouse suspicion」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Why not keep it in your breast pocket? It'd be super handy as a pointer stick!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahh, but even for self-defense, its practicality is kinda meh~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Indeed, a .22 caliber isn't very reassuring. At best, it's just for intimidation to scare someone off in a pinch, though……」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If that's the case, it'd be way better if it made a super flashy, loud BANG! instead~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「*Sigh*, what a predicament. It's a thoughtful gift and all, so I'd like to keep it on hand, but with a child's toy like this――」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you two talking about!? Isn't that sounding pretty dangerous!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oopsie, you shouldn't be eavesdropping, Synn-kun~ Girls have all sorts of things going on, you know~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Quite so. If you ever get close with Lolotte-san, President, perhaps you'll come to understand then.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm only getting more confused here, though……?」
True enough, a guy really shouldn't be eavesdropping on a conversation between two girls. I decide to fall back a few paces as we walk together.

name: Sacchin
message: 「The nib is so sharp, it's fun~ At the end, you can throw this like a shuriken~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「A flying kunai, yes. Of course, I have mastered that technique.」
……Let's put a bit more distance between us.
